items.question: What percentage of Americans say they prefer a human rather than automation to prepare their food at a restaurant?
items.context: Ipsos found the preference for human-prepared restaurant food has grown since 2023.
items.talk: Would you care if a robot prepared your meal as long as it tasted good?

items.question: When ordering fast food, what percentage of Americans say they would rather interact with a person than an automated system?
items.context: Three in four Americans told Ipsos they prefer human interaction when ordering fast food.
items.talk: Do kiosks make ordering faster, or do they turn customers into unpaid cashiers?

items.question: Nearly four in ten Americans say what issue is already affecting their personal finances?
items.context: Thirty-nine percent said extreme weather is affecting their finances a great deal or a fair amount.
items.talk: What weather-related expense has surprised you the most?

items.question: What percentage of U.S. adults say they use AI chatbots to search for information?
items.context: Searching for information was the most commonly reported chatbot use in Pew's 2026 survey.
items.talk: What have you stopped Googling because you now ask AI instead?

items.question: Among employed U.S. adults, what percentage say they use AI chatbots for tasks at work?
items.context: Pew found more than a third of employed adults report using chatbots for work tasks.
items.talk: What work task would you happily hand to AI forever?

items.question: What percentage of Americans said they had canceled a streaming subscription during the previous six months?
items.context: Ipsos reported the share had risen by 10 percentage points from the prior month.
items.talk: If you could keep only one streaming service, which one survives?

items.question: What percentage of Americans agree they can get better discounts online than in stores?
items.context: Ipsos found a strong majority believes online shopping offers better discounts.
items.talk: What do you still refuse to buy online?
